whole_scope_notes: All 51 catalogued C definitions/private helpers have owned Rust implementations or explicit safe ownership replacements; the symbol table retains the immutable per-symbol inventory.

FillRowLayout is a Copy-only local scalar record for the lower index owner’s five interval counts, stride, maximum edge count, and run count. FillInterval and PixelRun records stay in JobRasterScratch buffers admitted to the same RasterJob. RasterJob::compose validates the dash cache once per row; bounded records are copied by value for their traversal phase.

The frozen row runs its original center interval/run pass followed by slots 0, 1, 3, 4 across the exact 4×4 lattice. Binary-search comparisons, interval/run visits, candidate pixels, and paint samples are charged inside their actual loops.

All 11 assigned original cases have their owned pure assertion predicates exercised. Full decoded renderer/librsvg and native provider integration remain deferred; no lower-engine completion is inferred from shared API acceptance.
FrozenOracleOnly remains an explicit low-level oracle mode; the production fill-row entrypoint uses SourceOver.

Revision 2: original51 symbols and11 cases unchanged. Owned aggregate capacity guard and exact success/fallback/rollback proofs added. Near-cap rebuild succeeds with positive actual physical overlap; per-generation logical bytes remain distinct from caller-ledger physical charges.
